text:
sophia: Starting a controlled canary for service-x. Enabling feature flag `new-routing` at 5% now. Will monitor latency p95, 5xx, and token throughput.
release-bot: [deploy-job 1749998881] queued: canary rollout for service-x tag=v2.3.1 ff:new-routing=5% (initiated by sophia)
jamie.ops: preflight status? any holdpoints?
sophia: preflight passed: smoke tests, infra health, autoscale checks. Holdpoint at +15m for manual approval to 50%.
chen: FYI router-proxy requires pinning if we go >20% to avoid fanout to older route table.
andre: can we add a soft backpressure rule if p95 > 400ms?
sophia: added a throttling rule to deploy config: ```backpressure: p95_ms:400 action:attenuate50```
release-bot: [deploy-job 1749998881] cohort=5% allocated
jamie.ops: monitoring dashboards. tagging oncall @ryan.oncall
ryan.oncall: oncall ack. I'll watch SLOs. planned bump cadence?
sophia: bump to 20% at +10m if stable, manual approval at +15m for 50%.
release-bot: [metric-update] +5m latency_p95=185ms 5xx=0.01%
chen: seeing a small tail increase due to KV cache warm misses, within SLA.
andre: staging rate-limit vent to allow gradual increase.
sophia: bumping to 20% now.
release-bot: [deploy-job 1749998881] cohort updated -> 20%
release-bot: [metric-update] latency_p95=230ms 5xx=0.04%
jamie.ops: p95 creeping but under backpressure threshold. continue to monitor.
release-bot: [metric-update] +14m 5xx spike -> 0.8% :warning:
andre: spike correlates with upstream routing to v2.3.1. tagging model-team.
maria-exec: please advise quickly if rollback is needed.
sophia: options: attenuate cohort to 5% or rollback router-proxy to v2.3.0. thoughts?
ryan.oncall: attenuate to 5% immediately, capture heap of traces. If errors persist, rollback to v2.3.0 pinned.
jamie.ops: executing attenuation: `/deploybot attenuate --job 1749998881 --to 5% --reason "5xx spike"`
release-bot: [action] attenuation applied -> cohort=5%
release-bot: [metric-update] +3m after attenuation 5xx=0.12% latency_p95=210ms
sophia: stable but anomaly pattern remains. proposing rollback of router-proxy to v2.3.0.
chen: agree. rollback steps: pin router-proxy->v2.3.0, redeploy proxies, confirm KV cache warmup.
andre: I'll prepare rollback plan: pin -> staged apply -> monitor -> unpin if healthy.
jamie.ops: ready to run rollback on approval. cmd: `release-bot rollback --service router-proxy --to-tag v2.3.0 --reason "canary spike"`
sophia: approved, proceeding.
release-bot: [action] rollback initiated by sophia
release-bot: [rollback-job 1749999000] router-proxy -> v2.3.0 partial apply
release-bot: [rollback-job 1749999100] router-proxy -> v2.3.0 full apply
release-bot: [metric-update] post-rollback 5xx=0.03% latency_p95=180ms
ryan.oncall: SLOs restored. recommend holding flag at 5% and disabling auto-ramp until model fix.
sophia: holding `new-routing` at 5% and disabling ramp automation. opening ticket OPS-1421 with traces and dashboard snapshots.
chen: adding notes to runbook and tasks: investigate KV cache sequence and model routing mismatch.
maria-exec: thanks for quick mitigation. add one-line summary to release notes.
sophia: release notes summary: "Enabled `new-routing` canary at 5% -> ramped to 20% -> 5xx spike observed -> attenuated to 5% -> router-proxy rolled back to v2.3.0 -> stability restored. Flag held at 5% pending model fix."
jamie.ops: post-deploy checklist: monitor 60m, disable ramp automation, schedule model fix window.
ryan.oncall: I'll monitor overnight. marking thread resolved unless follow-ups needed. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: [note] ticket OPS-1421 opened for follow-up and dashboard snapshots attached
sophia: thanks everyone.
